hakoneGora.title: 箱根强罗别墅
hakoneGora.subtitle: GENSENSARYO GEN HAKONE GORA
hakoneGora.summary: 位于神奈川县箱根町强罗，是一家包含度假公寓的日式温泉酒店。酒店拥有80间客房，总面积达3,991平方米，部分客房设有独立汤池，为宾客提供私密的泡汤体验。

yutoreroGarden.title: Yutorero花园北轻井泽
yutoreroGarden.subtitle: YUTORELO GARDEN KITAKARUIZAWA
yutoreroGarden.summary: 位于群马县吾妻郡嬬恋村，是一家拥有76间客房的观光度假村。酒店客房总面积达7,763平方米，包含独栋度假小屋，为宾客提供私密的度假空间。

awajiSumoto.title: 淡路岛洲本别墅
awajiSumoto.subtitle: KISHU RAILWAY AWAJI-SUMOTO VILLA
awajiSumoto.summary: 位于兵库县洲本市，是一家拥有60间客房的精品度假式公寓酒店。酒店客房总面积2,538.13平方米，风景宜人。

kataseEnoshima.title: 片濑江之岛酒店
kataseEnoshima.subtitle: KATASE ENOSHIMA HOTEL
kataseEnoshima.summary: 坐落于神奈川县藤泽市片濑海岸，是一家拥有12间客房的公寓式酒店。酒店客房总面积295.63平方米，为宾客提供温馨舒适的住宿空间。

izuIppeki.title: 伊豆一碧湖湖畔露台
izuIppeki.subtitle: IZU IPPEKI LAKE LAKESIDE TERRACE
izuIppeki.summary: 位于静冈县伊东市，是一家拥有49间客房的温泉度假村。酒店客房总面积4,341平方米，兼具日式与西式房间设计，满足不同宾客的住宿偏好。

bosoShirahama.title: 房总白滨海乡酒店
bosoShirahama.subtitle: BOSO SHIRAHAMA UMISATO HOTEL
bosoShirahama.summary: 地处千叶县南房总市白浜町，是一家拥有73间客房的日式温泉酒店。酒店客房总面积达1,882平方米，配备80个停车位，为自驾游客提供便利。

nagoyaSakae.title: 名古屋荣自然酒店
nagoyaSakae.subtitle: HOTEL NATURE NAGOYA SAKAE
nagoyaSakae.summary: 地处爱知县名古屋市中区，是一家拥有53间客房的城市商务酒店。酒店客房总面积724平方米，地理位置优越。

bandaiAtami.title: 磐梯热海尤特里罗酒店
bandaiAtami.subtitle: YUTORIRO BANDAI ATAMI
bandaiAtami.summary: 位于福岛县郡山市热海町，是一家拥有41间客房的日式温泉度假酒店。酒店巧妙融合西式客房设计与传统日式温泉文化，提供完善的住宿体验。

nihombashi.title: 日本桥皇家广场
nihombashi.subtitle: NIHOMBASHI ROYAL PARK
nihombashi.summary: 位于东京都中央区的核心区域，毗邻东京站与皇居。作为江户五街道的起点，这座桥至今仍是日本道路网的象征性原点。

hakataGrant.title: 博多格兰特高地
hakataGrant.subtitle: HAKATA GRANT HEIGHTS
hakataGrant.summary: 位于九州岛北部福冈市。该城市以其悠久历史和现代活力完美融合而闻名。作为九州地区的交通枢纽，博多站是新干线的重要站点，连接着日本各地。

hamanako.title: 滨名湖别墅
hamanako.subtitle: HOTEL LISTEL HAMANAKO
hamanako.summary: 位于静冈县西部，临近日本著名的咸水湖，以其独特的自然环境与丰富的旅游资源成为备受青睐的度假胜地。

nankiShirahama.title: 南纪白滨别墅
nankiShirahama.subtitle: NANKI SHIRAHAMA VILLA
nankiShirahama.summary: 位于和歌山县南部白滨町。白滨町面朝太平洋，是关西地区最具代表性的海滨度假胜地。

biwako.title: 琵琶湖别墅
biwako.subtitle: BIWAKO VILLA
biwako.summary: 位于滋贺县中部，毗邻近日本最大的淡水湖琵琶湖。

izusan.title: 伊豆山别墅
izusan.subtitle: IZUSAN VILLA
izusan.summary: 位于于伊豆半岛东北部伊豆山地区。伊豆半岛曾被评为“关东地区最具人气的海滨度假胜地之一”。

kusatsu.title: 草津别墅
kusatsu.subtitle: KUSATSU VILLA
kusatsu.summary: 位于于群马县西北部草津町。草津町地处海拔约1200米的高原上，被浅间山、白根山等活火山环抱，是日本最具代表性的温泉胜地之一。

atamiAjiro.title: 热海网代别墅
atamiAjiro.subtitle: ATAMI AJIRO VILLA
atamiAjiro.summary: 位于静冈县东部热海市。靠近相模湾畔，距离东京仅约100公里，凭借新干线约50分钟即可抵达。

echigoYuzawa.title: 越后汤泽别墅
echigoYuzawa.subtitle: ECHIGO YUZAWA VILLA
echigoYuzawa.summary: 位于于新潟县南部的越后山脉腹地。越后汤泽是一座被群山环抱的温泉度假小镇。因诺贝尔文学奖得主川端康成的小说《雪国》而闻名。

shinshuSalt.title: 信州盐嶺别墅
shinshuSalt.subtitle: KASHIBESSO NATURE VILLAGE SUWAEN
shinshuSalt.summary: 坐落于长野县盐尻市，是一家拥有50间客房的度假村。酒店客房总面积3,561平方米，配备110个停车位，主打独栋度假小屋设计。

izuShuzenji.title: 伊豆修善寺别墅
izuShuzenji.subtitle: IZU SHUZENJI VILLA
izuShuzenji.summary: 位于静冈县最南端伊豆半岛，东濒太平洋。这片三面环海的半岛距东京仅约100公里，以温暖的气候、优美的海岸线和丰富的温泉资源闻名。

iseToba.title: 伊势鸟羽别墅
iseToba.subtitle: ISE TOBA VILLA
iseToba.summary: 位于三重县东南部，同属伊势志摩国立公园范围，拥有一条自然与人文完美融合的黄金旅游线路。

yonagoKaike.title: 米子皆生别墅
yonagoKaike.subtitle: YONAGO KAIKE VILLA
yonagoKaike.summary: 位于鸟取县米子市，坐落在日本海沿岸，是一处将海滨风光与温泉文化完美融合的度假胜地。

narukoOnsen.title: 鸣子温泉别墅
narukoOnsen.subtitle: NARUKO ONSEN VILLA
narukoOnsen.summary: 位于宫城县西北部的大崎市，坐落在奥羽山脉的幽静峡谷中。鸣子温泉是日本东北地区最具代表性的温泉乡之一。

numajiri.title: 沼尻裹磐梯别墅
numajiri.subtitle: NUMAJIRI KOKUSAI RESORT HOTEL
numajiri.summary: 坐落在福岛县耶麻郡猪苗代町，是一家以家庭客群为定位的日式温泉度假酒店。酒店拥有35间客房，总面积598.6平方米，营造出温馨舒适的住宿环境。

ashizuriMisaki.title: 足摺岬别墅
ashizuriMisaki.subtitle: ASHIZURI MISAKI VILLA
ashizuriMisaki.summary: 位于高知县土佐清水市足摺岬，地处四国岛最南端。足摺岬是足摺宇和海国立公园的核心景观区，被誉为"四国的天涯海角"。

nasushiohara.title: 那须盐原
nasushiohara.subtitle: NASUSHIOBARA VILLA
nasushiohara.summary: 位于日本栃木县北部。那须盐原位于那须连山脚下，以其丰富的自然景观、温泉和农业资源而闻名，是东京周边热门的旅游目的地之一。

creators_ecosystem.hero_subtitle: Here, art, technology, and life intertwine, where every creator finds their stage.
creators_ecosystem.hero_body: Kishu World is built upon the spirit of co-creation, inviting creators from across art, design, music, architecture, film, literature, and more to collaborate within a shared ecosystem. Through the combination of RWA and Web3 mechanisms, we aim to bridge creativity and real-world value, shaping a truly decentralized creative network.
creators_ecosystem.concept_subtitle: Creation is more than expression — let us co-create the future.
creators_ecosystem.concept_body: Kishu World is built on a self-sustaining cycle of Creation → Community → Economy → Re-Creation, forming an ever-evolving cultural network. Here, creation is not only an act of inspiration — it is the bridge between value and community. Every creative work — whether music, film, design, architecture, or literature — is recorded and authenticated through blockchain technology, transforming into a tradable object asset.
creators_ecosystem.mechanism_body_1: Once these works enter the Object Ecosystem, they gain not only collectible and cultural value but also become essential nodes driving the community’s cultural and economic growth.
creators_ecosystem.mechanism_body_2: Creators and holders together participate in building the Economic Ecosystem — through token rewards, governance voting, project proposals, and event collaborations, ensuring a positive feedback loop between creativity and value distribution. As creators gain influence and recognition, the system automatically rewards them through the network, encouraging continuous high-quality content and collaborative innovation. This mechanism transforms creation from individual expression into collective construction — from the birth of inspiration, to the generation of value, and finally to community feedback — forming a living, ever-growing creative ecosystem within Kishu World.

creator_types.title: Creator Types
creator_types.description: Kishu World's collaborative network connects global creators to jointly explore the infinite possibilities of the Web3 era.

object_ecosystem.hero_title: Space is the vessel of inspiration.
object_ecosystem.hero_subtitle: We believe that creativity needs real space to grow. That’s why Kishu World is not confined to the digital realm — it extends into the real world, through tangible lands and buildings. Each Creator Space becomes a node that connects inspiration, life, and community. Background: Concept visual of Creator Space.
object_ecosystem.concept_body: Value is created by the community — and returned to the community. In Kishu World, the economy is not a one-way transaction, but a co-creation cycle. We build a cultural economy supported by real assets and driven by community governance through a 'multi-layered token model' and 'points incentive system'.
